record.title: Public Pollen HAT Y1 — YXC OT3EL89CJI-111YLC-12M
record.origin_why: Pollen Robotics publishes the board BOM and PCB; PROVENANCE.json pins both. The footprint name does not establish oscillator manufacturer.
record.why: Public-board BOM Y1 identity resolved through its explicit LCSC C7425459 code to YXC OT3EL89CJI-111YLC-12M. This identifies the public BOM item, not a production Microduck specimen. One item is included in the HAT PCBA; no extra assembly purchase. Exact-code timing and solder-land conformance remain unresolved.
record.quantity_basis: One Y1 on the public HAT board; included within its PCBA BOM, do not add to complete-robot purchase quantities.
unknowns: The installed production Microduck HAT revision and oscillator marking are not confirmed.

Both downloaded PDFs are YSO110TR family documents, with no revision/date or full OT3EL89CJI-111YLC-12M order code printed. Exact-code timing/current guarantees remain CANNOT DETERMINE; family values are recorded separately, not silently promoted.
PCB uses an Abracon-named library footprint whose solder pads differ from the YXC recommendation; assembly yield/fit needs DFM review, not an assumed pass.
Actual +3V3 rail tolerance, output loading, measured startup, jitter and running current on hardware remain unmeasured.
